entries.reason: The workstream picker delegates its structural transaction to RenderSafe.mutateStructure, whose write callback is outside this lint's RenderSafe.mutate authority.
New-person creation delegates its receipt-bound structural transaction to RenderSafe.mutateStructure, whose create callback is outside this lint's RenderSafe.mutate authority.
Bulk document relocation is a structural rename transaction whose target is not the active source note; its frontmatter rewrite is part of that transaction.
Single-document relocation is a structural rename transaction whose post-rename frontmatter rewrite must remain adjacent to the rename.

The Home day-rollover watcher runs on workspace active-leaf-change and refreshes only when _shouldDayRefresh reports the recorded render day is no longer today; the wall clock is the authority, no vault write occurs, and no inserted or removed node exists for a structural receipt to roll back.

_toggleProjectsSort persists only the sauce.projects-hub.sort localStorage display preference and repaints ProjectsHubCards, a separately owned Dataview block this chrome instance holds no DOM handle for; no vault write can reject, so there is nothing to apply optimistically and nothing to roll back.

This is RenderSafe's own bounded reconciler, the single proven-index authority every other site defers to: it refreshes only after create mode observes dv.page(path) indexed, or an explicit mutation-specific isCurrent predicate returns literal true, never on a gesture and never on a bare metadata signal.

SaucePlugin._fireReconcile is the burst-aware background reconciler fired by the debounced vault-change timer, never by a DOM handler; there is no user gesture, no owned surface, and no optimistic DOM that a structural receipt could describe.

_reconcileAfterCreate fires only after polling dv.page(path) reports the newly created note indexed, or its bounded retry window expires, so the refresh is independently authoritative over Dataview's own index rather than a gesture redrawing from stale state.

TaskDialog._markDone renames the very note this card is rendered inside into spice/tasks/_done, so the gesture's own surface does not survive the awaited write: no owned node remains to insert or remove and no receipt exists for mutateStructure to roll back. This is the only gesture-scoped refresh left; its residual gap is index proof, tracked as a RenderSafe.mutate active-mode isCurrent migration.
